1.consolidated_definition: Enfermedad de peces, crustáceos y moluscos que produce en quien los come intoxicación o envenenamiento graves.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Fish and shellfish poisoning is a disease caused by consuming contaminated seafood that can lead to severe intoxication or envenoming.
